def popular_word(text):
    words = text.lower().split()
    ranked = sorted(set(words), key=lambda w: words.count(w), reverse=True)
    return ranked[0]

from collections import Counter

def most_common_word(text):
    words = text.lower().split()
    return Counter(words).most_common(1)[0][0]

def most_common_word(text):
    words = text.lower().split()
    pairs = []
    for w in set(words):
        pairs.append((words.count(w), w))
    pairs.sort()
    return pairs[-1][1]
